posts.title_en: ND러너: Holy Golden Drop Crumble Dungeon 180G+ guide, final edition
posts.summary_en: ND러너 (a top KR creator). Captain Milk; at mercenary Lv.4 Passion Pay plus Like A Family (elemental damage per cookie of the most-fielded element), which scored best; Rapid Promotion at Lv.3; General Perks below. Deployment is by power, not ATK: the 40 highest-power cookies deploy and the rest enter as they die. Pomegranate's beam goes to Projectile Speed synergy recipients first (Milk always), then by ATK; the best result came with Macaron and Figure as ATK #1 and #2 after Milk. Unwanted cookies go to Lv.1. Gear not yet studied. Runs vary by billions; the run shown ends at 174.7G ('1747억') with 14.14G total power, his record is in the high 180s G, and a bad run lands around 150G; spend every ticket to set a record. The pinned comment lists the 40 and the Lv.1 exclusions (evidence/08-extract/lineups.json, ndrunner-2026-09-18).

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 "황금갓방울 던전" 50G이상 팁 공략 가이드
posts.title_en: ND러너: Holy Golden Drop dungeon 50G+ tips
posts.summary_en: ND러너, before the 9/10 update. Run the dungeon at least once daily: participation crystals, daily top 10 pays pet tickets and research stones, bracket and weekly rewards pay XP and coins, score milestones pay crystals. The first 40 by power deploy together. Chargers such as Oven Wanderer pull aggro and move around the boss, and summoners spread the formation, so the range-limited buffs miss; the team should stay packed in the centre. Milk captain with Passion Pay; Milk must be top ATK counting the captain's +10%; Rapid Promotion second, also for Milk. Projectile Speed synergy recipients must be Lv.1 because they take the beam first (Milk excepted). Cheesecake is also Lv.1: its ATK buff replaced Milk's stacked ATK buff, which then restarted. Two options for the beam: Macaron and Figure at ATK #1-2 with dealers levelled below them, or let Milk and the main dealers take it.
mechanics: Buffs have a range; a packed formation keeps them on the dealers.
Before 9/10 Cheesecake's ATK buff erased Milk's stacks.

quotes.en: In this content the cookies' buff synergy matters a lot; the buffs have a range.

Pinned comment: Brightseeker with over 50 Skill Haste attacks with six drones. Comments: a viewer's Figure drifts right after the boss's jump attack; pets' ATK bonuses count toward ATK order.
mechanics: Brightseeker past 50 Skill Haste fields six drones.
The boss has a jump attack that knocks cookies around.

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 크럼블 던전 공략(250G 공략)
posts.summary_en: VART: following it averages over 200G. The 40 highest-power cookies deploy first and the rest after they die. ATK order Milk, Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure, Macaron, Cheesecake; the other 34 lowered only until they stay above the excluded cookies. Captain Milk, Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion. Milk must come out at once; for him lowering Pomegranate's level did it, and changing Scorpion's runes broke it again. 200G with his 40th cookie, 250G with a swap for Espresso. Pinned comment: use a Skill Haste / Skill AMP / damage-reduction preset. The run shown ends at 221,390,226,057 with 9G 225M total power, 1st, 2.033 s left (frames vart-end-19, vart-end-24, vart-027).
mechanics: Milk arriving at once is sensitive to small changes (levels, runes).

quotes.en: Milk 1st, Brightseeker 2nd, Scorpion 3rd, Figure 4th, Macaron 5th, Cheesecake 6th (caption, corrected for transcription)

posts.summary_en: 서신우: a mode decided by raw account strength ('체급'). Not all cookies fight at once: the 40 highest-power deploy and each death brings in one of the rest, so the weakest end up last. Sort by power in the collection. Milk is always ATK #1, Figure #2; Macaron #3 only for players with ATK runes on it; everyone else below Figure. Remaining slots go to fire-element and synergy cookies, because Like A Family scales with the most-fielded element; Schwarzwälder is left out as a charger. Perks: Milk captain; below mercenary Lv.4, the all-stats 2% perk. Dark Choco and Devil both kept: their DEF shreds should not stack, but runs with both kept setting records. Conquest gear showed no misses, so he fights on the Conquest preset. Score 127.1G at 10.15G (nv:46592).
mechanics: Like A Family rewards stacking one element among the 40.
